This prevents checking aggregation, the inclusive 50% threshold, scope exclusions, designation logic, or unsupported restrictions and permissions; it does not establish a substantive code defect.
Footnote 7 places the holistic designation assessment in cases below 50% of NAV. Designation factors are non-exhaustive considerations for the SFC, not independent automatic classification triggers.

Missing exposure or designation evidence must not silently become evidence that neither classification route applies. The circular does not resolve historical declassification after an exposure decline.
Footnote 1's 15% direct-investment limit is distinct from the 50% aggregate classification threshold. Assessing that separate limit would require UT Code section 7.3, which is not supplied.
The supplied missing dependency IDs have no identifying metadata linking them to named authorities. No catalogue mapping can be established.
